newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Tokai jv in Manila eyes Japanese clients.
newsitem.headline: Tokai jv in Manila eyes Japanese clients.

text.p: Global Business Bank, a joint venture bank of Tokai Bank Ltd and Metropolitan Bank and Trust Co (Metrobank), will focus its operation on the growing interest of Japanese investors in the Philippines, officials said on Tuesday.
"We will serve the financial needs of our Japanese clients in the Philippines," Tokai president Satoru Nishigaki told reporters through an interpreter.
He said Global Bank would introduce the Philippines as an investment site for businessmen relocating outside Japan.
Metrobank president Antonio Abacan said the country's newest commercial bank would complement the trade and project financing business of Metrobank.
Both officials said Global would also serve the local market through consumer lending and treasury operations.

The joint venture between Metrobank and Tokai, which holds 30 percent of Global Bank, also includes Hong Kong-based Paravision Ltd, which holds 10 percent, and two local real estate companies. Metrobank owns 49 percent of the bank.
Metrobank is the Philippines' largest bank, while Tokai is the seventh largest in Japan.
The two banks have a common shareholder, Toyota Motors Corp.
